Gypsy, Roma and Traveller (GRT)

35. There is a general lack of understanding that GRT are considered ethnic groups and legally
protected from discrimination along these lines.

36. Gypsies and Travellers report the poorest health compared to every other ethnic group, and
34% live in social housing.

396 Roma are also unlikely to own their own home; 75% live in
private rented accommodation, compared to 20% of the general population (although this
can be partially explained by the fact that the population is younger).
